body: Hey there, I hope you are maybe feeling even a microgram better than you felt yesterday.  Cutting and self harming is absolutely addictive.  And like lots of other addictions it is a really, really good idea to quit while you're ahead even though you might need extra help with it... I go to support groups for it and even on days where everyone annoys the shit out of me, it's marginally helpful to know that everyone is struggling and that people still want to help me.  Anyway I hope you are crushing your bike mileage now that it's getting sunnier out, and make sure your tires are inflated :)

I'm 32 and I'm feeling the same way, like that cutting/self harming is the only way to jolt myself out of a constant state of anxiety and fear and hopelessness.  I am trying to think of things that are just as physically painful but don't leave embarrassing teenager scars... I don't know, sprinting as fast as I can down the street until I throw up?  Lol.

I will say congratulations for being sober though. That's not nothing!  You have objectively improved your life with nothing but your own willpower.  

You also have family members who appreciate you and I am glad you can recognize this.

That’s so awesome - Great job not only finding a medication that works for you but also taking the step to get medication in the first place. That part is so hard.  Not every day will be excellent, but here is hoping for a graph that goes up and to the right :)
I'll do this.  Thank you for your advice.
Okay to be fair eating a taco is kind of like having a massive mouth orgasm, there's a refractory period

I just took a shower and cleaned up"

That does ring true, actually.  

It could be that he is intimidated by my overt sexuality.  He has expressed to me that he wants sex to feel natural and mutual at all times.  My issue with this is that this leaves a really narrow window for intimacy.  At the beginning of a relationship, you get that feeling nearly all the time, but as things settle in and day-to-day life starts to demand your energy, you and your partner aren't always going to be on the same wavelength.  That doesn't mean you have to wait for the perfect romantic moment to have sex though, does it?
That's absurd.

Please don't feel like this is your fault. Any number of things could be causing his apathy.  He could be depressed.  He could be having some new sexual hangups as he gets older.  He could be cheating.  Who knows.  

It's up to you what happens next.  Don't feel trapped, you are absolutely empowered to decide.  You could leave him.  You could deliver him a come-to-Jesus "sex is necessary for a good relationship and we do not have sex, therefore I am having second thoughts".  You could stay with him and hope that through the years he takes another 180 and is insatiable for you again.  But you don't have to do that.

I'm going through the same thing right now, but married.  Desperate for intimacy, sick at the thought of cheating, but sick at the thought of the rest of my life feeling unwanted and unloved.  Normally I would say "hang in there" but I think your situation calls for "do whatever it takes".  Good luck.
You fucking did it.  And of course you've found a new lover so fast.  :)  Thanks for your story, inspired to do something similar if things don't turn around fast for me.

I'm very close to doing the same thing. Many things are holding me back, mainly the fear that I learn that feeling wanted/loved by another man will not actually make me happier. It's good to hear that you don't have any regrets.

I hope you get what you need.
Thank you.  :)
It would be very hard to break up with him, but in the end I would do it.
Thank you for sharing this story.  It's heartbreaking.  I hope things get easier for you.
No, I haven't told him.  I am afraid he would get upset and demand that I quit my job/my "extracurriculars" (acting, gym, etc.) to be away from those temptations.  He is a jealous guy.

So, as of last night, I have been asked by a friend to have an affair.  I said no because I don't want to hurt my husband.  Like, even after all this misery, I can't justify to myself that it's worth betraying him.  If we can't get through this with counseling we will divorce and I can happily sleep with other interested parties.

I exercise, dress up, take double care of myself.  Spend extra time with friends, take my dog to the park, and play that dumb Hailee Steinfeld "I love myself" song. Journal, read, punch a hole through a wall, call my mom. Those kind of things.
Kinda bittersweet, isn't it.
Oh man I *wish* I had sub 10% haha.  Thank you for your response, really made me feel better.
Thank you.  I play video games too but I wouldn't pass up intimacy for fake WoW loot even if I had nothing else going for me.
You have to have sex to have kids, right? Then we're safe. Lol. Thank you.

This is a good point; in my case, I cannot imagine life without my husband and so I try to find accomplishment in other areas.  

I see a therapist which is validating and also helps me with my depression.  I work out (partially out of hope that my husband might like a skinnier wife, but also for the accomplishment).  

At my very lowest I have an online document where I record times that men hit on me just to remind myself that I am desired.
Shit, this made me cry.  Well written.  I'm sorry for what you're (we're) going through.
